content: The objective of this evaluation is to study the effectiveness of RQE for Medical Question Answering, by comparing the answers retrieved by the hybrid entailment-based approach, the IR method and the other QA systems participating to the medical task at TREC 2017 LiveQA challenge (LiveQA-Med).
